title: Review audit records in the V2-MOM-P001 health record

R1_persisted_fields.order: classifier order; never merged or de-duplicated

R2_count_consistency.review_pending_count: len(review_pending_items), same list (single source of truth)
pre_commit_checks: count == number of BLOCKING/HARD_FAIL classifier items
R2_count_consistency.on_failure: raise before runs/<D>.json is written; session stays unprocessed and is retried (v2.3 P5/P7)

R3_schema_marker.check_health: UNHEALTHY if a health_schema 2 record lacks review_pending_items or count != len
R3_schema_marker.legacy_records: records without health_schema (e.g. 2026-10-12) remain valid; never rewritten or backfilled

R4_plaintext_permission.added: non-performance review metadata (the seven R1 keys)
R4_plaintext_permission.snapshot_unchanged: raw corporate-action payloads and adjusted-price datasets are not added

invariants: identity resolution v2.0.1 C2 + v2.4 A1, review classification and statuses
session order, catch-up, idempotency P7, locking, retries, late flags
sealed ledger format, ledger_sha256, seal key, reveal time lock, --now refusal
all v2.3 P5 / v2.4 fail-closed checks, check_quarantine, endpoint guard, check_config_sha
historical artifacts, existing session records and snapshots

cases: all BLOCKING/HARD_FAIL items persisted with exactly seven keys
same entity/date items with different item label not collapsed
unavailable classifier keys stored as null
count mismatch or non-serialisable item raises before commit point; no runs/<D>.json
no performance/position keys and no seal-key value in the record
ledger_sha256 and classification identical for identical input
check-health: schema 2 without list or mismatched count UNHEALTHY; legacy record unaffected
v2.5 guard refuses missing/not-ADOPTED/mismatched/uncommitted; v2.4 and fwd-gate2 guards unchanged; existing suites pass
